passage:
A science center built a coral tank to teach visitors about ocean life. The corals looked like colorful rocks, but the guide explained that they were living animals.
Visitors learned that coral reefs support many kinds of fish. They also learned that warmer water and pollution can harm them.
A child asked why people should care about something far under the sea. The guide pointed to the tank and said many lives are connected in ways people do not see.
The child watched a tiny fish hide between coral branches.
The reef was small in the tank, but it showed a large idea: protecting one habitat can protect many lives at once.
